annotations.title: Comparable lets near the property and the rent they indicate

description:
Comparable lets for a market rent, and the rent they indicate. ASKING
    rents from portal adverts: no achieved rents exist, so say "asking" when
    you quote them. Reads the rent adverts of the nearest units (within 1 km,
    last seen in the 24 months before `as_of`), widening from 250 m and 6
    months until 4 effective comparables qualify. A let qualifies when it is
    the same type family (flats with flats, houses with houses; house shares
    and rooms never), the same bedrooms (+/- 1 only when exact cannot reach
    the minimum), and within 0.67-1.5x the subject's floor area when both are
    known; others come back with `flags`. Each let:
    address, distance, beds, floor area, first/last seen, `outcome`
    (let_agreed | withdrawn | live | unknown), first and last asking rent,
    reductions, days on market, the rent carried to the last complete month
    on the asking-rent index (`carried_rent_pcm`), `adjusted_rent_pcm` (equal
    to it while size adjustment is off) and its `weight` (distance, recency, size, beds,
    type; let agreed counts more, an unlet reduced asking rent less).
    `estimate`: central_pcm (weighted median, an achievable ASKING rent),
    low_pcm/high_pcm (80% range; back-tested on let-agreed adverts: median
    miss 10%, 80% coverage), n_effective, and asking_to_achieved_ratio
    (ONS paid rents over the local asking median for the bedroom band, capped
    0.85-1.05, 1.0 with ratio_source `none` when no cell) published BESIDE
    the estimate, not applied. `time_on_market_days`: median days to let
    agreed for the comparable lets. The property's own adverts are never
    comparables; its latest is `subject_advert`. `status` ok | thin |
    no_comparables | location_unavailable. PASS `beds`, `property_type`
    (flat | terraced | semi-detached | detached | bungalow) and
    `floor_area_m2` whenever you have established them: the unit record's
    bedrooms are imputed for most properties, and a wrong bedroom count
    doubles the miss (`subject.attributes_source` says what was used).
    `as_of` YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (default today); `limit` 1-30.
    UK only. Costs 10 credits (10p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
name: valuation_rent_comparables
title: Comparable lets near the property and the rent they indicate
